title: One Day in Tianjin
description: Steven describes a weekend trip to Tianjin, where he took his drone after a new law banned drones in Beijing. He covers cheap rents and packed commuter trains, a Starbucks Reserve inside a 1921 bank, an Apple Store visit, a guard at St. Joseph's Cathedral who asked him to prove he was Catholic, and why they skipped the Tianjin Eye.

sentences.en: The main points in brief

sentences.zh: В сего́дняшнем вы́пуске Сти́вен расска́зывает о Тяньцзи́ни.
sentences.en: In today's episode, Steven talks about Tianjin.
It's a city not far from Beijing.
Steven went there for the weekend.

sentences.zh: Он взял с собо́й свой дрон.
sentences.en: He took his drone with him.

sentences.zh: Дрон — э́то ма́ленький лета́ющий аппара́т с ка́мерой.
sentences.en: A drone is a small flying device with a camera.

sentences.zh: Вчера́ весь вы́пуск был про дрон.
sentences.en: Yesterday the whole episode was about the drone.
Today it's the real story of the trip.
Here's what's in it:
the train from Tianjin to Beijing;
a beautiful Starbucks café in an old bank;

sentences.zh: магази́н Apple, где Сти́вен переду́мал тра́тить де́ньги;
sentences.en: the Apple store, where Steven changed his mind about spending money;

sentences.zh: сторо́ж у це́ркви, кото́рый попроси́л дока́зать, что Сти́вен католи́к;
sentences.en: a guard at a church who asked Steven to prove he was Catholic;
the "Tianjin Eye", a huge wheel with cabins.
They didn't go there.
Why Tianjin, and why now

sentences.zh: С э́тих выходны́х в Пеки́не нельзя́ име́ть дро́ны.
sentences.en: Since this weekend, you are not allowed to have drones in Beijing.
This is a new law.

sentences.zh: Он по́явился по́сле слу́чая в ию́не.
sentences.en: It appeared after an incident in June.

sentences.zh: Отпра́вить дрон по по́чте Сти́вен не смог.
sentences.en: Steven couldn't send the drone by mail.

sentences.zh: Поэ́тому они́ сами́ повезли́ его́ в Тяньцзи́нь.
sentences.en: So they took it to Tianjin themselves.
Tianjin is an old friend of Steven's.

sentences.zh: Из Пеки́на туда́ о́чень легко́ добра́ться.
sentences.en: It's very easy to get there from Beijing.
The fast train takes half an hour.

sentences.zh: В го́роде живёт о́коло 14 миллио́нов челове́к.
sentences.en: About 14 million people live in the city.
There is a big seaport there.

sentences.zh: Они́ жи́ли в оте́ле о́коло Удада́о.
sentences.en: They stayed at a hotel near Wudadao.
It means "Five Great Avenues."
There are more than 200 buildings there.
They are already a hundred years old.

sentences.zh: Они́ сде́ланы в ра́зных за́падных сти́лях.
sentences.en: They are built in various Western styles.

sentences.zh: Сти́вен шу́тит: «Если хо́чешь пое́хать в го́род, Тяньцзи́нь — непло́хой вы́бор».
sentences.en: Steven jokes: "If you want to go to a city, Tianjin is not a bad choice."
Cheap rent and full trains

sentences.zh: Отдыха́ть в Тяньцзи́нь е́здить не сто́ит.
sentences.en: It's not worth going to Tianjin to relax.
There are a lot of people there.
People stare at you.
To relax, a dacha is better.
A dacha is a house outside the city.
The main thing in Tianjin is the prices.
An apartment in Beijing costs 6,000 yuan.

sentences.zh: В Тяньцзи́ни така́я же сто́ит 3000–4000 юаней.
sentences.en: In Tianjin, the same kind costs 3,000–4,000 yuan.

sentences.zh: Поэ́тому по́езда хо́дят ка́ждые пять-де́сять мину́т.
sentences.en: That's why trains run every five to ten minutes.

sentences.zh: И всё равно́ би́летов не хвата́ет.
sentences.en: And there still aren't enough tickets.

sentences.zh: Осо́бенно в воскресе́нье ве́чером и в понеде́льник у́тром.
sentences.en: Especially on Sunday evening and Monday morning.
Many people buy an apartment in Tianjin.

sentences.zh: А в Пеки́не на неде́лю снима́ют ко́мнату за 1000–1500 юаней.
sentences.en: And in Beijing, people rent a room for a week for 1,000–1,500 yuan.
Would Steven do that?
No.

sentences.zh: На́до покупа́ть биле́ты, проходи́ть про́верку и бежа́ть на по́езд.
sentences.en: You have to buy tickets, go through the security check and run for the train.
That's too much hassle.

sentences.zh: Для туристов и тех, кто живёт в Китае
sentences.en: For tourists and those who live in China

sentences.zh: Мно́гие тури́сты е́здят в Пеки́н, Сиа́нь и Шанха́й.
sentences.en: Many tourists go to Beijing, Xi'an and Shanghai.
They skip Tianjin.

sentences.zh: Но е́сли вы неде́лю в Пеки́не, съезди́те туда́ на оди́н день.
sentences.en: But if you're in Beijing for a week, take a day trip there.
It's easy and inexpensive.

sentences.zh: Гла́вные места́ мо́жно уви́деть за полдня́.
sentences.en: You can see the main sights in half a day.

sentences.zh: Но́мер в оте́ле сто́ил о́коло 300 юаней в бу́дний день.
sentences.en: A hotel room cost about 300 yuan on a weekday.
A buffet breakfast was included.

sentences.zh: В суббо́ту но́мер сто́ил о́коло 500 юаней.
sentences.en: On Saturday the room cost about 500 yuan.
Steven also met a friend.
They have known each other for 20 years.
The friend recently moved from Busan.
It's a city in South Korea.

sentences.zh: В оте́ле была́ стекля́нная дверь в ва́нной.
sentences.en: The hotel had a glass door on the bathroom.
Steven jokes: "It would be nice to put on some music."
There was thick smog outside.
Steven asked for an air purifier.
First they brought him an aroma diffuser.
"That's not the same thing!"
Then they found an air purifier after all.
Heping Street and Starbucks Reserve

sentences.zh: Они́ пое́хали на велосипе́дах на у́лицу Хэпи́н.
sentences.en: They rode bikes to Heping Street.
It's a long shopping street.

sentences.zh: Там мно́го еды́ и стра́нных ла́вок.
sentences.en: There's lots of food and strange little shops there.
There's even a "chocolate museum."
The chocolate there looked like paper.
At the end of the street stands a Starbucks Reserve.
It is in a bank building from 1921.

sentences.zh: В нём есть стекля́нный ку́пол и мра́морные коло́нны.
sentences.en: It has a glass dome and marble columns.
There is also an old bank counter.
It is already a hundred years old.
Bloggers were filming themselves with desserts.
Steven was filming too.

sentences.zh: Но он говори́т: «Я совсе́м не бло́гер».
sentences.en: But he says, "I'm not a blogger at all."
Coffee and a pastry cost 70–75 yuan.

sentences.zh: Оба поду́мали: почему́ мы не вари́м хоро́ший ко́фе до́ма?
sentences.en: They both thought: why don't we make good coffee at home?

sentences.zh: Зато́ в торго́вом це́нтре чи́стые туале́ты.
sentences.en: On the other hand, the mall has clean toilets.
That's a plus!
The Apple Store and the foldable iPhone
Next door was an Apple Store.

sentences.zh: Подру́га Сти́вена зна́ет: на но́вый айфо́н у него́ нет де́нег.
sentences.en: Steven's girlfriend knows he doesn't have the money for a new iPhone.

sentences.zh: Айфо́н 14 Про Макс сни́мал почти́ 90 проце́нтов виде́о Сти́вена.
sentences.en: The iPhone 14 Pro Max filmed almost 90 percent of Steven's videos.
The new iPhone 18 isn't much better.

sentences.zh: Сти́вен говори́т: «Де́ло не в телефо́не, а в том, кто снима́ет».
sentences.en: Steven says: "It's not about the phone, it's about who's filming."
His girlfriend didn't like the foldable iPhone "Duo".
You can't reach across it with one hand.

sentences.zh: Э́то пе́рвая моде́ль, и она́ до́рогая.
sentences.en: It's the first model, and it's expensive.

sentences.zh: Ноутбу́к Макбу́к с сенсо́рным экра́ном понра́вился бо́льше.
sentences.en: She liked the MacBook laptop with a touchscreen more.

sentences.zh: Но Сти́вен ещё не заплати́л за ста́рый Макбу́к.
sentences.en: But Steven still hasn't paid off his old MacBook.

sentences.zh: Поэ́тому он пошёл в магази́н, что́бы вы́кинуть из головы́ мысль о поку́пке в долг.
sentences.en: So he went to the store to get the idea of buying on credit out of his head.
St. Joseph's Cathedral

sentences.zh: На друго́м конце́ у́лицы стои́т собо́р Свято́го Ио́сифа.
sentences.en: At the other end of the street stands St. Joseph's Cathedral.
It's a working Catholic church.

sentences.zh: В воскресе́нье тури́стов туда́ не пуска́ли.
sentences.en: On Sunday, tourists weren't allowed in.
A man at the gate asked: "Are you Catholic?"
Steven answered: "Yes."
Then the guard said: "Prove it. Cross yourself."

sentences.zh: Сти́вен вы́рос в украи́нской католи́ческой семье́.
sentences.en: Steven grew up in a Ukrainian Catholic family.
The rituals there are a bit different.
He forgot which shoulder comes first.
They didn't go into the church.

sentences.zh: Фарфоровый дом и «Глаз», куда они не пошли
sentences.en: The Porcelain House and "the Eye", where they didn't go

sentences.zh: Фарфо́ровый дом в Удада́о — э́то ви́лла в францу́зском сти́ле.
sentences.en: The Porcelain House in Wudadao is a French-style villa.

sentences.zh: Её покры́ли о́чень мно́гими кусо́чками фарфо́ра.
sentences.en: It was covered with a great many pieces of porcelain.
Admission costs 50 yuan.

sentences.zh: В интерне́те пи́шут, что э́то обма́н.
sentences.en: People online say it's a rip-off.
They didn't go there.
Instead, Steven was filming a video.

sentences.zh: Он гро́мко говори́л по-англи́йски и держа́л телефо́н.
sentences.en: He was speaking loudly in English and holding his phone.

sentences.zh: Собрала́сь толпа́ и ста́ла снима́ть его́.
sentences.en: A crowd gathered and started filming him.
He told himself: "Don't let me down, Steve."
It worked on the third try.
His friend found reviews from two women.

sentences.zh: Они́ ката́лись на «Тяньцзи́ньском глазе» и пото́м расста́лись.
sentences.en: They rode the Tianjin Eye and then broke up.
In Chinese, this kind of bad luck is called "daomei".

sentences.zh: Сти́вен и подру́га сказа́ли: «Суа́нь ле» — ла́дно, не идём.
sentences.en: Steven and his friend said: "Suan le" — okay, we're not going.
Buns, "pineapple" bread and pink bicycles
Tianjin has famous Goubuli buns.

sentences.zh: Назва́ние зна́чит приме́рно «соба́ки не обраща́ют внима́ния».
sentences.en: The name roughly means "dogs pay no attention".

sentences.zh: Все в интерне́те о́чень рассерди́лись на одно́ кафе́ из-за плохо́го отзы́ва.
sentences.en: Everyone online got very angry at one café because of a bad review.

sentences.zh: Сти́вен и подру́га взя́ли гонконгский хлеб-«анана́с».
sentences.en: Steven and his friend got Hong Kong "pineapple" bread.
There's no pineapple in it.
On top is a sweet crust with a checkered pattern.
Inside there's butter, cream or ice cream.
Steven ordered a matcha.

sentences.zh: Он откуси́л — и вспо́мнил, что не лю́бит ма́тчу.
sentences.en: He took a bite and remembered that he doesn't like matcha.
But he finished drinking it anyway.

sentences.zh: На вокза́л они́ е́хали на ро́зовых велосипе́дах.
sentences.en: They rode to the train station on pink bicycles.
The smog was throwing off the navigation.

sentences.zh: Перево́з дро́на сто́ил Сти́вену о́коло 1200 юаней.
sentences.en: Shipping the drone cost Steven about 1,200 yuan.
Now the drone is sitting in Shanghai.

sentences.zh: Что с ним де́лать, Сти́вен пока́ не зна́ет.
sentences.en: Steven doesn't know yet what to do with it.
Main idea

sentences.zh: Тяньцзи́нь дешёвый, бли́зкий и о́чень краси́вый.
sentences.en: Tianjin is cheap, close and very beautiful.

sentences.zh: Туда́ сто́ит съе́здить на оди́н день.
sentences.en: It's worth going there for a day.

sentences.zh: Но «Тяньцзи́ньский глаз», мо́жет быть, лу́чше пропусти́ть, е́сли вы дорожи́те свои́ми отноше́ниями.
sentences.en: But maybe it's better to skip the Tianjin Eye if you value your relationship.
